summary: German expatriate living in the US, software developer with a background in Python and Ruby, strong interest in machine learning, passionate about programming and technology, enjoys cooking and ceramics, critical of US law enforcement and political corruption, advocates for social justice and against the death penalty, has a nuanced view on immigration and citizenship, values historical context and cultural heritage, expresses concern over urban planning and traffic management, prefers public transportation and walkable communities, has a critical view of the US education system, and is interested in renewable energy and environmental issues.
